product.title: Oahu: Grand Tour Around Island with Snorkeling

description.text: With just one day, you can see 16 of Oahu’s greatest sights and still have time for snorkeling—if you hop on this tour. Across one whirlwind day, you’ll witness Diamond Head State Monument, the Halona Blowhole, the Dole Plantation, and so much more. You’ll capture fantastic photos, learn all about the island’s history, and go snorkeling, topping off the day surrounded by Oahu’s colorful marine life.Make the most of your time on the island, hitting all the best spots with a guide See Makapu'u Beach, Kahuku Farms, Waimea Bay, and beyond Snacks and snorkeling gear provided Hassle-free hotel picku Ideal for travelers basing in Honolulu who want a guided Oahu experience without coordinating transport, gear, or admission tickets on their own.
